source (exact): Huang et al., 2D Gaussian Splatting, SIGGRAPH 2024, arXiv 2403.17888, sec. 4.2 (html)
terms and weights as published: L = L_c + alpha L_d + beta L_n; L_d = sum_ij w_i w_j |z_i - z_j| (depth distortion, z_i = ray-splat intersection depth); L_n = sum_i w_i (1 - n_i^T N), N from the median-depth point map gradients; alpha = 1000 (bounded scenes) / 100 (unbounded), beta = 0.05; median depth z_median = max{z_i | T_i > 0.5} preferred for meshing (TSDF voxel 0.004, truncation 0.02)
what it targets in the G1 decomposition: behind-surface spread and surface thickness (precision 'behind'); normal noise
fit for GaME (3D Gaussians): not the same role on 3D Gaussians: z_i is the exact intersection with a 2D disk and n_i its normal; GaME's primitives are 3D Gaussians (no intersection depth, no normal) -> would need a primitive change or a substitute definition (unsourced)
cost / risk: rasterizer forward/backward for the distortion and normal maps

source (exact): Chen et al., PGSR: Planar-based Gaussian Splatting for Efficient and High-Fidelity Surface Reconstruction, arXiv 2406.06521 (html)
terms and weights as published: L = L_rgb + lambda1 L_s + L_geom; L_s = ||min(s1,s2,s3)||_1 (flattening), lambda1 = 100; unbiased depth D(p) = d / (N(p) . K^-1 p~) from blended plane distance and normal; single-view L_svgeom = 1/W sum (1 - grad I)^2 ||N_d(p) - N(p)||_1, lambda2 = 0.015; multi-view photometric NCC on 7x7 patches through the homography H = K_n (R - T n^T / d) K_r^-1, lambda3 = 0.15; multi-view geometric forward-backward reprojection error with w = 1/exp(phi) for phi < 1 else 0, lambda4 = 0.03; L_rgb with lambda = 0.2 (D-SSIM); 30000 iterations
what it targets in the G1 decomposition: behind-surface bias (unbiased depth), thickness (flattening), floaters and normals (single- and multi-view consistency)
fit for GaME (3D Gaussians): same role: PGSR regularises ordinary 3D Gaussians (flattened), as GaME uses; the multi-view terms need neighbouring keyframes (GaME keeps them)
cost / risk: unbiased depth and normals need rasterizer outputs (plane distance, normal maps: ul_rasterizer); multi-view NCC adds per-iteration homography warps; changes GaME training for every row (rows 1, 3, 4 alike, stated as 'GaME + PGSR')

terms and weights as published: fuse the keyframes' measured depth at the same views and TSDF as the median export; decompose both
what it targets in the G1 decomposition: recall 'observed' misses (row 1 C: 2.48 pp) -- if the measured-depth control misses them too, they are keyframe coverage of the export, not geometry; regularisation would not recover them
